 Hon'Ble Vikram D. Chauhan, J.
1 .  Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned AGA for the State.

2. This application has been filed by the applicant for quashing the charge sheet dated 29.06.2024 as well as entire proceedings of Session Case No.1258 of 2025 (State Versus Shivam @ Shubham)
pending in the court of District and Session Judge, Hapur arising out of Case Crime No.779 of 2023 under Sections 498A, 323, 506, 313, 325 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Hapur Nagar, District Hapur.

entities.text: Session Case No.1258 of 2025 (State Versus Shivam @ Shubham)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. After some arguments, learned counsel for the applicant prays that the applicant may be permitted to move appropriate application before the Court concerned as provided under Section 250(2) of the BNSS.

4. This prayer has not been opposed by the learned A.G.A.
5.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the applicant is permitted to appear before the concerned court within 15 days from today and move an application claiming discharge.
The concerned court shall after hearing the counsel decide the application on merits, in accordance with law expeditiously.
6. For a period of 30 days, no coercive action will be taken against the applicant.
7. With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.
(Vikram D. Chauhan,J.) September 3, 2025 VMA  Shivam Alias Shubham vs State Of U.P. And Another on 3 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50998892/
